newsitem.title: USA: Ibis sees Q2 shr loss $0.12-$0.16.
newsitem.headline: Ibis sees Q2 shr loss $0.12-$0.16.

text.p: Ibis Technology Corp said Friday it expects a second quarter net loss of $0.12 to $0.16 a share.
According to First Call, the consensus analyst earnings estimate for Ibis's second quarter is break-even, compared to a loss of $0.05 a share a year earlier.
Ibis attributed its forecast loss to lower than anticipated orders, the repair and maintenance of the first Ibis 1000, and use of the second Ibis 1000 for SIMOX-SOI wafer development.
Ibis supplies SIMOX-SOI wafers to the semiconductor industry. The silicon-on-insulator wafers are for the production of integrated circuits.
The company produces SIMOX-SOI wafers on proprietary Ibis 1000 oxygen implantation equipment.
